rows.name: Portman
rows.reason: Portman fetches OpenAPI URLs, generates Postman collections and invokes Newman. Separate configurations/files are proposed grouping; GUI workspaces, licensing and historical availability remain unverified.

rows.name: Postman v12 Lightweight API Client (signed out)
rows.reason: Signed-out mode offers tabs and history; saving collections and entering workspaces require sign-in, so it fails the required grouped, portable workspace workflow.

rows.name: Postman v12 Lightweight API Client (signed out)
rows.reason: The specified signed-out mode lacks the required workspace grouping: official v12 documentation requires sign-in to enter workspaces and save collections. Signing in changes the supplied configuration.

rows.name: Noodle
rows.reason: Noodle combines OpenAPI import, file-based request collections, Postman export and selective CLI execution in a terminal client. Direct specification-URL input and availability at the 2020 cutoff were not established.

rows.name: SOAPdenovo2
rows.reason: SOAPdenovo2 assembles genomic sequencing reads into contigs and scaffolds. Its documented input and execution model do not provide the requested REST API testing workflow.

rows.name: SOAPdenovo2
rows.reason: SOAPdenovo2 assembles genomic sequencing reads from FASTA, FASTQ or BAM files; it provides no REST request, OpenAPI import or API-workspace testing mechanism.

rows.name: SoapUI
rows.reason: Keep provisionally: file-backed projects, workspaces and CLI are documented. Direct OAS URL import remains unverified; the Open Source documentation limits supported specification versions.

rows.name: OpenAPI-to-Postman with Newman
rows.reason: Converts OpenAPI files into portable collections; Newman runs all or selected requests. URL specifications require downloading. Graphical workspace editing, licensing, and cutoff availability remain unverified.

rows.name: SoapUI Open Source
rows.reason: GUI project grouping, XML portability and selective CLI tests documented. Opened support lists Swagger/OAS2, not OAS3; URL import unverified. Test-suite construction required; some runner features need ReadyAPI.

rows.name: Milkman with HTTP and CLI plugins
rows.reason: JavaFX workspace/OpenAPI 3.0 importer and selective request CLI documented. Arbitrary-URL import, workspace export/reimport, whole-workspace execution and Postman export unverified; JavaFX does not prove native UX quality.

rows.name: SoapUI
rows.reason: Project XML, request grouping, and selective CLI execution fit; Swagger/OpenAPI 2.0 support and unresolved direct-URL import prevent claiming a complete match.

rows.name: SoapUI Open Source
rows.reason: SoapUI Open Source supports grouping, portability and selective CLI tests. Direct URL import remains unverified; documentation covers OAS 2.0, not assumed 3.x. Historical 2020-01-08 features remain unverified.
